say:1:1522006001:1.text: Since it isn't showing up, we have to do something to lure it out.
say:1:1522006001:1.source_cn: 既然金鳞蛇皇不肯主动出现，我们就只能想办法引出它了。

say:2:1522006002:1.text: I bet it's got the same taste as the Hunting Goddess! We could use food she'd like, especially stuff with a strong scent! I'm sure it'll come out!
say:2:1522006002:1.source_cn: 它是狩猎神召唤的怪物，喜好什么的肯定和狩猎神差不多！我...

say:4:1522006003:1.text: But... what does the H-Hunting Goddess like?
say:4:1522006003:1.source_cn: 可是狩……狩猎神，喜欢什么？

say:6:1522006004:1.text: Legend has it that the Hunting Goddess drinks the <style="highlight">divine elixir</style> before going to battle.

say:7:1522006005:1.text: Divine elixir? How do we prepare that?
say:7:1522006005:1.source_cn: 祭神蜜露？那东西怎么做？

say:11:1522006007:1.text: It needs lots of <style="highlight">honey</style>, <style="highlight">spiky coconuts</style>, and <style="highlight">spiralfern</style>.

say:13:1522006008:1.text: Spiralfern? Us hunters know nothing 'bout that kinda stuff.
say:13:1522006008:1.source_cn: 卷蕨草是什么？俺们只会打猎，不懂这些啊。
